${product.product_name}

Tags: ${product.tags}

`).join(''); ctx.type = 'text/html'; }); // Post a new product router.post('/recommender', async (ctx) => { const { product_name, tags } = ctx.request.body; if (!product_name || !Array.isArray(tags)) { ctx.throw(400, 'Invalid input'); } const db = await initDb(); await db.run(` INSERT INTO products (product_name, tags) VALUES (?, ?) `, [product_name, tags.join(',')]); ctx.status = 200; ctx.body = { message: 'Product added successfully' }; }); // Use body parser and router app.use(bodyParser()); app.use(router.routes()).use(router.allowedMethods()); // Start the server const PORT = 5000; app.listen(PORT, () => { console.log(`Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`); });

import sqlite3

def test_query(tags):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('db.sqlite3')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Constructing the SQL query dynamically based on the number of tags
    placeholders = ' OR '.join(['tags LIKE ?'] * len(tags))
    sql_query = f'SELECT * FROM products WHERE {placeholders}'
    parameters = [f'%{tag}%' for tag in tags]
    
    cursor.execute(sql_query, parameters)
    results = cursor.fetchall()
